meta.title: Apply for Hospital Indemnity Coverage | Isaac Plans
meta.description: Start your hospital indemnity application online — cash paid directly to you if you're hospitalized. Secure, guided, and only a few minutes.
meta.imageAlt: Apply for hospital indemnity coverage with Isaac Plans

hero.title: Cash paid to you if you end up in the hospital
hero.subtitle: A hospital stay shouldn't drain your savings. Start your secure application online — it only takes a few minutes.

benefits.title: Money paid straight to you
benefits.desc: Benefits are paid to you, not to the hospital — so you decide where the money goes.

benefits.title: Use it for anything
benefits.desc: Cover your deductible, rent, groceries, childcare, or lost income while you recover.

benefits.title: Works alongside your health plan
benefits.desc: It pays on top of whatever coverage you already have, including a marketplace or employer plan.

benefits.title: Bilingual, licensed support
benefits.desc: Get help in English or Spanish from a licensed advisor at every step.

steps.title: Open your secure application
steps.desc: Tap Apply now and your private application opens immediately — no account, no password. Come back on this device anytime to pick up where you left off.

steps.title: Fill out the secure form
steps.desc: Answer a few guided questions about you and anyone else you want covered. Everything is encrypted and saves automatically as you go.

steps.title: We review and reach out
steps.desc: Once you submit, we review your application and contact you to finalize your benefit amount and start date.

hospitalIndemnityApply.secureNote: Your information is encrypted and never shared. This process is 100% secure.
hospitalIndemnityApply.ctaNote: No account or password needed — your progress saves automatically as you go.
